455-1418-2226.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
455-1418-2226.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Hoverguard Sweepers by paying its mana cost.
When Hoverguard Sweepers enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama (and up to two other target creatures) to their owners' hands.
Repeat.

1479-5621-7889.description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Dancing from Dark to Dawn, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

670-1619-3742-6154.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-3742-6154.description:
Cast Phantom Steed by paying its mana cost.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield, causing White Plume Adventurer to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When White Plume Adventurer enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the White Plume Adventurer trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Phantom Steed from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Phantom Steed enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, exiling White Plume Adventurer until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Phantom Steed.
Repeat from step 5.

372-961-7487.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Against All Odds exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-961-7487.description:
Cast Against All Odds by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Zealous Lorecaster and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Zealous Lorecaster trigger.
Resolve the Zealous Lorecaster trigger, returning Against All Odds from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Against All Odds.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Zealous Lorecaster and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5686-6972-7229.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Ambitious Dragonborn.
When Ambitious Dragonborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat.

2034-5170-6132-7286.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, South Wind Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and South Wind Avatar trigger.
Resolve the South Wind Avatar trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
South Wind Avatar triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2829-6835-6972.description:
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Overseer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.

343-2366-5702-6633.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-5702-6633.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

132-2024-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that share a creature type.
132-2024-7013.description:
Activate Myr Welder using White Lotus Tile's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/W}{G/W}{G/W}{G/W}.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Myr Welder and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-4013-4030-5004-6643.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Cathodion, adding {C}{C}.
When Cathodion dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Edgar.
Cast Cathodion from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Repeat.

2060-2919-4222-4773.description:
Activate Overgrown Arch by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Overgrown Arch.
Repeat.

1193-2743-6231.manaNeeded: {2}{U} plus enough mana to cast the copy spell
1193-2743-6231.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least twice this game.
1193-2743-6231.description:
Activate Thunderclap Drake by paying {2}{U} and sacrificing it.
Cast Mythos of Illuna by paying its mana cost, targeting Biovisionary.
Thunderclap Drake triggers, copying Mythos of Illuna at least twice, with all copies targeting Biovisionary.
Resolve all Mythos of Illuna spells, creating at least three copies of Biovisionary.
At the beginning of your end step, each Biovisionary triggers, causing you to win the game.

141-2511-6476.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U} plus enough mana and/or cards in your graveyard to cast Afterlife from the Loam
141-2511-6476.description:
Cast Afterlife from the Loam by paying at most {5}{B}{B}{B}.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Afterlife from the Loam.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Afterlife from the Loam, targeting Naru Meha and any other creature(s) as desired.
Resolve the copy of Afterlife from the Loam, returning the targeted creatures from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

791-3693-5934-6093.notablePrerequisites:
There are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to give Walking Ballista lifelink.
Walking Ballista has at least two +1/+1 counters on it, or your life total is at least 4.
791-3693-5934-6093.description:
Give Walking Ballista lifelink, if needed.
If Walking Ballista has less than two +1/+1 counters on it, activate Unspeakable Symbol by paying 3 life, putting a +1/+1 counter on Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista's second ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 4 damage to an opponent or a permanent an opponent controls, and causing you to gain 4 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

2018-4050-5263.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero, adding one mana of any color.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader, adding one mana of any color.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

2060-4518-5283-5296.notablePrerequisites: Crystalline Crawler and Workhorse each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
2060-4518-5283-5296.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {1}{W}.
Inexorable Tide triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Workhorse and Crystalline Crawler.
When Kor Skyfisher enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

575-3585-4121-4955.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that does not have Grafted Wargear attached.
575-3585-4121-4955.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Birchlore Rangers.
If Grafted Wargear was attached to a creature, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it was attached to.
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to another creature.
Grafted Wargear triggers, causing you to sacrifice Birchlore Rangers.
When Birchlore Rangers dies, Yedora triggers, returning Birchlore Rangers from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
When Birchlore Rangers enters the battlefield, Greensleeves triggers, creating a 3/3 Badger creature token.
Activate Birchlore Rangers by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Birchlore Rangers' morph ability by paying {G}, turning it face up.
Repeat.

1395-2510-5078.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Semblance Anvil.
1395-2510-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

2034-4044-4920-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ornithopter of Paradise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ornithopter of Paradise dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter of Paradise on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Ornithopter of Paradise from the top of your library by paying {2}.
Repeat.

710-2292-2730.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

647-2563-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control with an egg counter on it.
You control at least one additional creature.
An opponent cannot block and kill creatures you control.
647-2563-3259.description:
Declare Xira and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Xira triggers, putting an egg counter on any other creature you control.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Xira.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to any other creature you control with an egg counter on it, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
When the creature that had Breath of Fury attached dies, Xira triggers, causing you to draw a card and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat each combat phase.

877-3184-4050-4645.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing The First Sliver, adding one mana of any color.
Yomiji triggers, returning The First Sliver from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast The First Sliver for {0}.
Resolve the First Sliver's cascade ability.
The First Sliver enters the battlefield.
Repeat.

1283-2034-2421-4005.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Syrix, adding {2}.
Choose not to move Syrix from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Skyfire Phoenix, adding {2}.
Skyfire Phoenix dies, triggering Syrix, causing you to pay {4} to cast Syrix from your graveyard.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1306-2073-4241.description:
Tap Crypt to add {2} to your mana pool.
Pay {1} Karn's ability on Mana Crypt to make it a 0/0 Artifact Creature.
Crypt dies, triggering Station's untap trigger.
Tap Station to return Mana Crypt to the battlefield.
You have {C} floating.
Repeat until you have enough colorless mana.

849-2034-2577-5115.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Gravecrawler, adding {C}{C}.
Anax triggers, creating a 1/1 Satyr creature token.
Activate Gemstone Array by paying {2}, putting a charge counter on it.
Activate Gemstone Array by removing a charge counter, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat any number of times.
Activate Ashnod's Altar any number of times by sacrificing any number of Satyr tokens, adding any amount of colorless mana.
Activate Gemstone Array any number of times by paying any amount of colorless mana, adding any number of charge counters.
Activate Gemstone Array any number of times by removing any number of charge counters, adding any amount of colored mana.
